title: Plan AB: AI Ad & Seed Video
summary: Product insight → creative script → visuals / live footage → editing → ad variants
scenario: For brand feed ads and seed videos, producing ad variants in volume and iterating on performance.

steps.title: Product insight
steps.detail: Gather product materials, competitor ads and real user reviews; distill the target audience's pains and your differentiators into an 'audience × pain × selling point' matrix that feeds every creative.
steps.tips: The sharpest pains come from negative reviews — complaints are selling-point opportunities.

steps.title: Creative script
steps.detail: Write several creative scripts on the matrix — pain opener, scenario demo, before/after, call to action — and draft three different hooks for each script.
steps.tips: Hook with a concrete number or a counterintuitive claim; 'did you know' hooks underperform.

steps.title: Visuals / live footage
steps.detail: Generate product demos and usage scenes with video models, polish hero shots in Midjourney, use HeyGen avatars for talking-head spots, or mix with live footage.
steps.tips: Generate the same product in several lighting and scene variants so you have levers for ad testing.

steps.title: Editing
steps.detail: Cut a 15-30 second feed version with big captions, a hard hook in the first 3 seconds and brand exposure at the end; export 9:16, 16:9 and 1:1.
steps.tips: Feed ads mostly play on mute — bold captions and on-screen text are mandatory.

steps.title: Ad variants
steps.detail: Combine different hooks, selling-point orders and visuals into 5-10 variants, run a small-budget test, and scale only the variants whose CTR and CVR clear the bar.
steps.tips: Find the top 20% of variants with small budgets first — never go all-in on a single unproven cut.

pitfalls.title: Claims that cross the line
pitfalls.detail: Ad regulations are strict about efficacy claims; run AI copy through a compliance review.

pitfalls.title: Hook and body out of sync
pitfalls.detail: Promises in the opener that the body never delivers tank conversion and drive refunds.

pitfalls.title: A single version
pitfalls.detail: Feed ads are discovered by testing; one version rarely pops.

pitfalls.title: No brand exposure
pitfalls.detail: Pure seeding with no brand leaves the traffic unclaimed.
